title: Tori Kelly sets Manila, Cebu shows for 2027 ‘God Must Really Love Me’ tour

blocks.text: Grammy-winning American singer-songwriter Tori Kelly is returning to the Philippines for back-to-back concerts in June 2027 as part of her “God Must Really Love Me World Tour.” Kelly will first perform at The Filinvest Tent in Alabang, Muntinlupa, on June 5, 2027, and then she will head to the Mactan Expo in Cebu the following night, June 6. The upcoming shows support Kelly’s latest studio album of the same title, which was released in June 2026 highlighting the artist’s powerhouse vocals and soulful sound.
